edges.reason: Constructor reads msg.sender to assign the initial owner.
msg.sender is written into the owner state variable, defining the privilege root.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender with owner to gate privileged functions.
onlyMarketManager compares msg.sender with marketManager or owner.
ownershipTransfer is guarded by onlyOwner.
initialize is guarded by onlyOwner.
setHandlerID is guarded by onlyOwner.
setHandlerAddr is guarded by onlyOwner.
setSiHandlerAddr is guarded by onlyOwner.
migration is guarded by onlyOwner.
handlerProxy delegatecall is restricted to marketManager or owner.
siProxy delegatecall is restricted to marketManager or owner.
handlerViewProxy has no modifier, so any msg.sender can reach an arbitrary delegatecall.
siViewProxy has no modifier, so any msg.sender can reach an arbitrary delegatecall.
LinkHandlerProxy constructor invokes the base proxy constructor.
deposit builds the payload and performs handler.delegatecall.
withdraw triggers handler.delegatecall.
borrow triggers handler.delegatecall.
repay triggers handler.delegatecall.
handlerProxy performs handler.delegatecall with provided data.
handlerViewProxy performs handler.delegatecall with provided data.
siProxy performs SI.delegatecall with provided data.
siViewProxy performs SI.delegatecall with provided data.
migration calls erc20Instance.transfer.
DEPOSIT signature string is consumed when encoding the deposit payload.
REDEEM signature string is consumed when encoding the withdraw payload.
BORROW signature string is consumed when encoding the borrow payload.
REPAY signature string is consumed when encoding the repay payload.
The handler state variable is the delegatecall target; whoever controls it gains execution in proxy storage context.

Delegatecall executes foreign code in the proxy's context, which can re-enter public proxy functions.
Delegatecall inside withdraw can re-enter withdraw or other public entries.
Delegatecall inside borrow can re-enter public proxy functions.

External ERC20 transfer in migration can call back into the proxy before completion.
